## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Why do you need it?

**Example:** I'm always frustrated when [...]

## 💡 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or features?

## 📸 Mockups/Examples

If applicable, add mockups, sketches, or examples from other apps.

## 📱 Use Case

Describe a typical scenario where this feature would be used.

**Example:**
1. User opens the app
2. User navigates to [...]
3. User taps [...]
4. Feature activates and [...]

## 🎨 UI/UX Considerations

How should this feature look and feel?

## ⚙️ Technical Considerations

Any technical aspects or implementation ideas (optional)?

## 📊 Priority

How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] Critical - Can't use the app without it
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve my experience
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Just an idea

## 🔗 Related Issues

Are there any related issues or feature requests?

## 📋 Additional Context

Add any other context or information about the feature request.
